2608.12150.title: Who Thinks Best Depends on How Long You Let Them: Budget-Dependent Rankings in LLM Evaluation
2608.12150.paper_summary: Standard evaluation of large language models assumes stable model rankings across inference conditions. We challenge this assumption by varying the token generation budget, i.e., the maximum tokens a model may produce, across seven levels (64--4,096), evaluating four models on three reasoning benchmarks (56,476 inferences). We report four findings: (i) 3--19% of items exhibit non-monotone behavior (accuracy decreasing with more budget), even after controlling for truncation, and this phenomenon is model-specific (cross-model overlap: 6--14%). (ii) Model rankings reverse across budgets on all benchmarks ($p {<} 0.01$, McNemar). (iii) Oracle analysis reveals model complementarity up to $+27.8$pp, most pronounced at constrained budgets. (iv) A budget-aware router captures 14.1% of the oracle gap cross-domain; budget features help within-domain ($+1.6$ to $+5.7$pp) but are domain-specific and hurt transfer ($-1.2$pp). These results argue for budget-conditioned evaluation protocols.
2608.12150.paper_summary_zh: 標準的大型語言模型評估假設在推理條件下模型排名是穩定的。<lb/>我們通過在七個級別（64--4,096）中變化標記生成預算，即模型可能產生的最大標記數，來挑戰這一假設，並在三個推理基準上評估四個模型（56,476 次推理）。<lb/>我們報告了四個發現：（i）3--19%的項目顯示出非單調行為（準確率隨著預算增加而下降），即使在控制截斷後，這一現象是特定於模型的（跨模型重疊：6--14%）。<lb/>（ii）在所有基準上，模型排名在不同預算之間顛倒（$p {<} 0.01$, McNemar）。<lb/>（iii）Oracle分析顯示模型之間的互補性高達$+27.8$pp，在受限預算下最為明顯。<lb/>（iv）一個考慮預算的路由器在跨領域中捕捉到14.1%的oracle差距；預算特徵在同領域內有幫助（$+1.6$到$+5.7$pp），但是特定於領域的，並且對轉移有負面影響（$-1.2$pp）。<lb/>這些結果主張需要基於預算的評估協議。
